scope: 117 DeepSeek High attempts from the fixed three-condition study; 39 attempts per condition = 13 tasks x 3 repeats. Read-only resource/error review, no new runs or regrading.
method: Provider request intervals clipped to native agent start/end and unioned per trial. Active-at-deadline uses the fixed 600-second boundary. Token counts are provider-reported metadata, including streams that settled after timeout; reasoning content is not read or reproduced. Inflight time includes server wait, generation and network delivery, not model compute alone. Missing usage is not imputed.
